title: Production Log Investigation
description: The API failed during the night. The useful request ID is hidden among ordinary log entries.
mission: Find the request_id on the ERROR line and write only that ID into answer.txt.
success: You extracted the failing request ID from the log.

lesson.what_happened: Filtering by severity isolated the failed request from routine traffic.
lesson.be_careful: Preserve request IDs so related logs can be correlated across services.
